  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

description: The 2026 RAM 1500 Big Horn Crew Cab 4x4 with the 6'4'' box is a mid-level trim that offers a blend of style, comfort, and work-ready capability. For the 2026 model year, the RAM 1500 continues its evolution with key updates to the engine lineup and technology, making it a highly competitive choice in the full-size pickup truck market. The Crew Cab and 6'4'' box combination provides a great balance of passenger space and cargo length. ### Key Features and Performance * **Engine Options:** The 2026 RAM 1500 Big Horn offers a choice of two main engines: * **Standard Engine:** The 3.6-liter Pentastar V6 with eTorque is standard on this trim. This engine produces 305 horsepower and 269 lb-ft of torque. It is a solid, efficient choice for everyday use. * **Available Engine:** An optional 3.0-liter Hurricane Twin-Turbo I6 is available. This engine delivers a significant boost in power, with 420 horsepower and 469 lb-ft of torque, providing enhanced capability for demanding towing and hauling tasks. The legendary 5.7-liter HEMI V8 has also returned for the 2026 model year on certain trims and may be available on the Big Horn as well. * **Transmission and Drivetrain:** All engines are paired with a smooth-shifting 8-speed automatic transmission. This specific model is a 4x4, equipped with a part-time four-wheel-drive system for enhanced traction. * **Ride and Handling:** The RAM 1500 continues to lead its class with its coil-spring rear suspension, which provides a ride that is notably smoother and more comfortable than trucks with a traditional leaf-spring setup. * **Towing and Payload:** The Big Horn is a highly capable truck. When properly equipped with the Hurricane I6, it can tow up to 11,570 pounds and haul a payload of up to 1,980 pounds. With the standard Pentastar V6, the maximum towing capacity is 8,110 pounds, and the maximum payload is 2,370 pounds. * **Dimensions:** The Crew Cab and 6'4'' box configuration provides a spacious cabin with ample rear legroom and the long box offers a cargo length of 76.3 inches. ### Interior and Technology The interior of the 2026 RAM 1500 Big Horn is a major selling point, offering a blend of comfort and modern technology that rivals more expensive trims. * **Infotainment:** The truck comes standard with the Uconnect 5 infotainment system and an 8.4-inch touchscreen display. It includes wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. An optional 12-inch touchscreen display is also available. * **Seating and Comfort:** The Big Horn features comfortable cloth seating, with bucket seats and a center console available as an option. The Crew Cab configuration offers a very spacious rear seat. Optional packages can add features like heated front seats and a heated steering wheel. * **Other Features:** Standard features include remote keyless entry, push-button start, and a 6-speaker audio system. The 2026 model year also sees the availability of a customizable 12.3-inch digital driver display. ### Exterior and Styling The 2026 RAM 1500 has a refreshed exterior design that is both modern and bold. The Big Horn trim maintains its classic style with some updated touches. * **Exterior Accents:** It features a chrome grille and chrome front and rear bumpers. It rides on 18-inch cast-aluminum painted wheels. * **Lighting:** The Big Horn comes with new, redesigned LED headlamps and standard LED fog lamps, which provide excellent visibility and give the truck a modern look. ### Safety The 2026 RAM 1500 Big Horn comes with a solid list of standard and available safety and driver-assistance features. * **Standard Safety:** Standard features include a rearview camera, rear parking sensors with a stop function, and Blind Spot Monitoring with Rear Cross-Path and Trailer Detection. * **Available Features:** The optional Big Horn Level 2 Equipment Group adds more advanced safety features, such as Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop and Go, Lane Keep Assist, and Forward Collision Warning with Active Braking.

The original hot hatch continues to thread the needle between fun, practicality and value with its trademark Teutonic elan. Count the Volkswagen Golf GTI among a very small group of vehicles that have remained in near-constant production for over four decades without veering far from the laser-focused intent of the original. The 2022 redesign marks the GTI's eighth generation in the States, and although the styling is comparably svelte and contemporary, its "box with an edge" attitude remains in full effect. Motivation is provided by a 241-hp turbocharged 2.0-liter four-cylinder mated with either a six-speed manual transmission or, for those who'd rather not bother with a third pedal, a seven-speed automatic. GTI's come only with front-wheel drive. Drivers of all sizes will find plenty of room and a comfortable driving position, while the four-door hatchback shape allows rear passengers surprising head and shoulder room with some space for cargo behind them. Practical, yes, but it's the baked-in sportiness that takes top billing here, the GTI serving up thrills and satisfying handling at any speed. Though the GTI has a built-in fan base bordering on the obsessive, its welcoming demeanor and forgiving dynamics make it easy for new owners to slip behind the wheel and get in on the fun. The term hot hatch has been applied to numerous vehicles in the last forty years, but it was coined for the Golf GTI, that tells you everything you need to know. With the manual transmission, our long-term Golf GTI S managed a 5.8-second run to 60 mph, which is 0.5 seconds quicker than its previous-generation equivalent. The Golf GTI's interior is a mix of modern touches and some subtle and tasteful nods to its storied legacy.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Head-up display - Keep your head up! You don't have to take your eyes off of the road to get information from your dashboard anymore. With head-up display, important driving information - like speed and RPM's - displays on your windshield in your line of sight. Because when you're driving, the most important information lies on the road ahead. Keep your eyes on the road with head-up display.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

Elevate your driving experience with the exceptional 2024 GMC Sierra 1500 Elevation. This powerful and versatile truck is designed to conquer any terrain, while offering a premium, well-appointed interior that will make every journey a pleasure.

With 4-wheel drive and a 10-speed automatic transmission, this truck is ready to tackle any task, whether it's conquering the great outdoors or navigating the daily commute with ease.

The interior of the Sierra 1500 Elevation is a true sanctuary, with premium leather seating, a heated steering wheel, and a state-of-the-art infotainment system that keeps you connected and entertained. The Elevation Premium Package adds even more luxury, with features like a Bose premium sound system, wireless charging, and a surround-view camera system.

Safety is also a top priority, with advanced driver assistance technologies like Adaptive Cruise Control, Forward Collision Alert, and Lane Keep Assist ensuring you and your passengers arrive at your destination with peace of mind.

Whether you're hauling heavy loads, towing a trailer, or simply enjoying the open road, the 2024 GMC Sierra 1500 Elevation is the ultimate companion. Its uncompromising blend of capability, technology, and comfort make it a standout in the full-size truck segment.

Experience the ultimate in capability and comfort with the 2024 GMC Sierra 1500 AT4. This powerful and versatile truck is designed to conquer any terrain, while providing a luxurious and feature-packed interior that will elevate your driving experience.

- Adaptive Cruise Control
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- AT4 Premium Package
- Backup Camera
- Bedliner

- Bluetooth

The Sierra 1500 AT4 is equipped with a robust EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine, delivering an impressive 420 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque. Paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and powerful 4-wheel drive, this truck is ready to tackle any terrain with ease. Whether you're hauling heavy loads, towing a trailer, or navigating off-road adventures, the Sierra 1500 AT4 has the power and capability to get the job done.

Elevate your driving experience with the premium features and technology that set the Sierra 1500 AT4 apart. Enjoy the convenience of wireless charging, the clarity of the Bose 7-speaker sound system, and the added safety of features like Blind Spot Monitoring and Rear Cross Traffic Braking. The AT4 Premium Package takes things even further, with the addition of a Rear Camera Mirror, Multicolor Head-Up Display, and Off-Road High Clearance Steps.

Designed with your comfort and convenience in mind, the Sierra 1500 AT4 offers a spacious and well-appointed interior. Sink into the plush, heated and ventilated leather seats, and take advantage of the dual-zone climate control, power-adjustable driver's seat, and heated steering wheel. The intuitive infotainment system with built-in navigation and wireless connectivity keeps you connected and in control.
